description: Mandates Governance is the federation organisation that sustains the Powers mandate ecosystem. It funds development and audits of individual mandates and governs which mandates are listed in the canonical MandateRegistry, including the registry's paid-tier settings (credit-to-wei exchange rate, protocol fee, and earnings withdrawal). It holds its own treasury (the Powers contract itself, in test USDC) and requests its operating budget from Core Governance through a cross-organisation funding request that both organisations must approve. Elected Mandate Assessors govern funding, audits, and registry listings; an elected Security Council vetoes registry additions and reform.
